halgrave-massing/eye-crossing: the eye shot for `anchor/crossing` is an EMPTY frame (1 distinct colour(s)) — a body standing at [44, 9, 435] and looking south sees nothing but flat background. The view runs 0 open cell(s) and then leaves the template. If this anchor is meant to face outward (an approach, a threshold), what it is about lives in the assembled world, and its real view is the campaign's own player-POV shot, not a per-piece render. Otherwise the piece is missing the thing the anchor names. Whatever the cause, no image in this set shows what that anchor is about; the fix is the anchor or the geometry, never the camera
